% book-template.tex -- master document for the whole book.
% Stage 08 copies this to definition/tex/<slug>.tex and fills every line
% marked FILL from book-brief.md, run-config.md and the book plan's
% "Chapter Order". Do not edit the template itself for one book.
%
% FILL: engine magic comment, from run-config.md "TeX engine"
% !TEX program = pdflatex
\documentclass[11pt,a4paper,openany]{book} % FILL: paper size from run-config.md
\usepackage{defn}
\usepackage{macros}       % generated by stage 02 from notation.md
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

\title{TITLE\\[1ex]\large (EDITION)} % FILL: the Title and Edition rows of book-brief.md
\hypersetup{pdftitle={TITLE (EDITION)}} % FILL: same
\author{AUTHORS}                     % FILL: authors from book-brief.md
\date{YEAR}                          % FILL: year from book-brief.md

\begin{document}
\frontmatter
\maketitle
\tableofcontents
\include{preface}

\mainmatter
\include{introduction}
% FILL: one \include per chapter, in the book plan's Chapter Order, e.g.
% \include{syntax-core}
% \include{syntax-modules}
% \include{static-core}
% \include{static-modules}
% \include{dynamic-core}
% \include{dynamic-modules}
% \include{programs}

\appendix
% FILL: one \include per appendix, in Chapter Order, e.g.
% \include{appendix-derived-forms}
% \include{appendix-full-grammar}
% \include{appendix-static-basis}
% \include{appendix-dynamic-basis}

\backmatter
% FILL: \bibliographystyle and \bibliography if the book cites sources
\end{document}
